common_not_found_intro: The link may be old or mistyped. Try one of these instead:
common_pay_fine: One-time payment, no subscription. For failed or canceled requests, credits are eligible for return when rejection before submission is confirmed or the provider’s final charge is zero. Credits are not yet returned while billing is pending; provider-charged requests are not automatically refunded. See the refund policy.
common_plan_for_selection: This pack alone covers up to {count} requests at your current settings ({cost} credits each).
common_plan_one_for_selection: This pack alone covers one request at your current settings ({cost} credits).
common_plan_not_enough_for_selection: This pack alone does not cover one request at your current settings ({cost} credits each).
common_sign_in_dialog_note: No password. Your prompt stays here. Eligible new verified accounts can receive one trial voucher, valid for 30 days from registration, subject to daily availability.
common_sign_in_google_failed: Google sign-in failed. Try again or use your email.
common_sign_in_google_unavailable: Google sign-in is unavailable. Use your email instead.
common_sign_in_invalid_code: The code is incorrect or has expired. Please check it or request a new code.
common_billing_checking_note: Usually a few seconds. Keep this tab open.
common_billing_paid: Payment received. Credits have been applied to your account.
common_billing_pending_before: We could not confirm this payment yet. Check your
common_billing_pending_after: for the order status before paying again. Contact support if you need help.
common_account_debt: {debt} credits were taken back after a refund or chargeback. They'll come out of your next purchase.
common_sign_in_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
common_checkout_failed: Could not start checkout. Please try again. If the problem continues, contact support.
common_plan_saving: About 20% less per credit than Starter
common_trial_claimable: A registration trial voucher is available to claim. Refresh to check availability.
common_trial_used: Your registration trial voucher has been used.
common_trial_expired: Your registration trial voucher has expired.
common_trial_daily_limit: Today’s registration voucher allocation is full. It resets at 00:00 UTC. Check again while your account is eligible.
common_trial_unverified: Verify your account email to check your registration trial voucher.
common_trial_sign_in: Sign in to check your registration trial voucher.
common_trial_ineligible: No registration trial voucher is available for this account. Any existing credits keep their original terms.
common_trial_load_failed: Could not check trial availability. Refresh to try again.
common_trial_note: One voucher per eligible new verified account, subject to daily allocation. It is separate from credits and the daily device trial. An accepted request uses the voucher, including if it later fails or is cancelled.
common_results_failed_pending: failed; billing status is pending and credits have not yet been returned. Do not resubmit. Contact support@freeaivideo.app with task ID {jobId}.
common_results_failed_charged: failed; the provider charged for this request and credits have not been returned. Contact support@freeaivideo.app with task ID {jobId} if you need help.
common_results_canceled_pending: canceled; credit return pending. Do not resubmit. Contact support@freeaivideo.app with task ID {jobId}.
common_results_canceled_charged: canceled; provider charged and credits not returned. Contact support@freeaivideo.app with task ID {jobId} if you need help.
